content.description: Omni-chain perpetual DEX with unified margin support. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Aboard Exchange redefines how users interact with decentralized derivatives. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Arbitrum and Avalanche and Solana to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Aboard Exchange stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
